canonical_statement: For every compact Hausdorff oriented n-dimensional real manifold M, possibly with boundary, cap product with the selected relative fundamental class induces for every natural q an isomorphism from compactly supported integral cohomology H_c^q(M; Z) to relative integral homology H_(n-q)(M, boundary M; Z).
statement_selection: The repository source says only 'the duality theorem for manifolds with boundary'. This node selects the standard compact integral Poincare-Lefschetz form. Compact support equals ordinary support for the selected compact domain. Noncompact finite-type and local-coefficient generalizations are uncredited alternates, not silently folded into the target.
